message.content: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","agent_id":"researcher","description":"Search current (today's) Indian news across major national and reputable international outlets. Identify the top 5–8 stories that matter today (politics, economy, national incidents, technology/business, foreign relations, and notable state-level items). For each story, record: a 1-sentence headline-style summary, 1–2 sentence context/why-it-matters, the primary source name, a direct URL, and the timestamp of the article. Prioritize primary reporting from established outlets and flag any items that are developing or unverified. Save the findings as a structured JSON list.","dependencies":[],"produces":"news_findings.json","consumes":[],"rationale":"Fetch and compile today's factual news items using live search","needs_tools":["web_search"]},{"id":"s2","agent_id":"creative","description":"Read the structured news findings file and write a short user-facing brief titled 'Today in Indian News' (about 200–350 words). Begin with a 1-line headline summary, then present 4–6 concise bullet/paragraph items summarizing the top stories with 1–2 sentences each, include one-sentence context where helpful, and add source links (use URLs from the findings). Keep tone neutral and suitable for a quick morning brief; include the date at the top. Save as a Markdown file.","dependencies":["s1"],"produces":"india_news_brief.md","consumes":["news_findings.json"],"rationale":"Convert gathered facts into a concise, polished brief for the user","needs_tools":["read_file","write_file"]}]}
